verdict.rationale: Cerebras documents dedicated endpoints: private, provisioned instances reserved for one organization, running on capacity not shared with other customers. Fine-tuned models can be deployed to them through a management API, which covers the isolation and deployment core of the story. Nothing in the pack documents autoscaling of that dedicated capacity, and the hardware is Cerebras-provisioned rather than described as GPUs. Missing for 10: documented autoscaling for dedicated endpoints, independent or hands-on corroboration of dedicated isolation.

support.subject: As an ml-engineer, I can deploy a model on dedicated GPU capacity with autoscaling so my traffic is isolated from the shared serverless pool

citations.quote: A dedicated endpoint is a private, provisioned instance of the Cerebras Inference service reserved exclusively for your organization.
Your endpoint runs on reserved capacity that is not shared with other customers, so your performance is never impacted by other workloads.
Upload fine-tuned models from your S3 bucket, track multiple versions, and deploy them to your [dedicated endpoint](/dedicated/overview).
